title: prunus divaricata subsp. turcomanica
intro: Prunus divaricata subsp. turcomanica, commonly known as Bukhara plum, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The Bukhara plum is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, providing potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Prunus divaricata subsp. turcomanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
